note.zh-TW: 「銷貨債權」直譯自日文売上債権，就是應收帳款；台灣報表每個科目只有一行淨變動。T12、T15 回覆後再定主要顯示。
note.en: The Japanese-style label means trade receivables; Taiwanese statements show one net-change line per account. The main display will be settled after T12 and T15.

definition.zh-TW: 應收帳款增加表示有些銷貨還沒收到錢，收入裡有一部分不是現金，所以要從稅前淨利減掉。
definition.en: When receivables rise, part of the revenue has not yet been collected, so that amount is deducted from profit before tax.
